items.title: 61520_Teddy Edwards oral history interview
items.q: Redd Foxx and Slappy White, all those guys will tell who the best one was -- it was Willie Lewis.

ctx.x: In the meantime, the tenor player from the band had left also, and he had come back to Los Angeles, Gene Montgomery -- because his father owned the poolroom downstairs under the Civic Hotel; and he lived in the hotel. And a lot of great people lived in and out of the Civic Hotel. I met a lot of great people.

That's where I first met...not the first time I met him, but he was living there...the great comedian, Willie Lewis. I had worked with him in Detroit when it was Spizzy and Willie. This guy was probably the funniest guy I ever heard, really. He had an incredible sense of humor. He never really got it big, but Redd Foxx and Slappy White, all those guys will tell who the best one was -- it was Willie Lewis. And he was the master baton twirler. He could put a hat over his face and twirl two batons, and do all kind…
